{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern 'dependency_aware_step_selection' aims to skip steps based on traced dependencies. For a linter like codespell, the dependency is the source code. I am implementing a dependency-aware check using `tj-actions/changed-files` to detect if any files (excluding the ignored patterns) have changed since the last commit. This implements the mechanism of skipping the step when the 'dependency' (the file tree) has not changed, as requested by the pattern, even though the performance gain for a simple linter might be marginal.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null
jobs:
  codespell:
    name: Check for spelling errors
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v44
        with:
          # We exclude the same patterns codespell ignores to ensure we don't trigger on ignored files
          files: '**/*'
          separator: ','
          exclude_glob: '.git,*.png,*.jpg,*.svg,*.sum'
      - name: Run codespell
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@e3258cca84ce02b0bb36a3d41f2c18f719a0cc1a # v2.4.3
        with:
          check_filenames: true
          skip: ./.git,./.github/workflows/codespell.yml,.git,*.png,*.jpg,*.svg,*.sum
          ignore_words_list: "AKS,aks"
"
}
